crossRefs.note: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised…
I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should…
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it, and will surround us, and cut off our name from…

translations.web: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’
translations.bsb: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
translations.kjv: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
translations.asv: Because Jehovah was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
